oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0'. A pull request into develop that touches an EmDash theme and carries no ci:e2e label has no tests emdash-* row; the row is recorded in leftOut with label ci:e2e and wouldRun true, the scope is partial:db+e2e, and the notice names the label. The same pull request with ci:e2e gets only the row of the theme it touched; with unreadable labels it keeps the row and leaves nothing out. Pull requests into main and staging, workflow_dispatch and schedule run every EmDash row and the e2e row, labels or no labels, and leave nothing out. A change that touches no theme records no EmDash row as left out.
